# UtilForge — Zero-Server Client-Side Data & File Utilities
> https://utilforge.pages.dev provides 40 zero-server client-side developer utilities, 292 interactive "X vs. Y" cloud/AI/payment cost calculators, and 26 production-ready SaaS boilerplates, MCP servers, and AI automation workflows.

## Client-Side Developer & FinOps Utilities
- [JSON ↔ CSV Converter & Nested Flattener](https://utilforge.pages.dev/json-to-csv/): Transform deeply nested JSON objects or arrays into clean RFC-4180 CSV tables—or convert CSV back to structured JSON—with 100% local browser execution and zero server uploads.
- [Client-Side Image Compressor & WebP Converter](https://utilforge.pages.dev/image-compressor/): Shrink image file sizes by up to 80% using hardware-accelerated HTML5 Canvas encoding directly in your browser. Zero upload queues, zero file-count limits.
- [Interactive Regex Tester, Highlighter & Group Extractor](https://utilforge.pages.dev/regex-tester/): Inspect every regex match, named or numbered capture group, character index, and execution time with one-click pattern presets.
- [Side-by-Side Text & Code Diff Checker](https://utilforge.pages.dev/text-diff-checker/): Spot additions, removals, and modified configuration lines instantly with longest-common-subsequence (LCS) diffing—100% private in your browser.
- [JWT Token Decoder & Expiration Inspector](https://utilforge.pages.dev/jwt-decoder/): Debug OAuth2 and OpenID Connect Bearer tokens safely. Decode Base64Url headers and payloads with human-readable timestamps and zero network calls.
- [SQL Query Formatter, Beautifier & Minifier](https://utilforge.pages.dev/sql-formatter/): Turn unreadable single-line SQL queries into clean, standardized clauses with configurable keyword casing and indentation.
- [Base64 / URL Encoder & WebCrypto SHA Hash Generator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/base64-hash-studio/): Unicode-safe Base64 and URL encoding paired with hardware-accelerated Web Crypto SHA-256 and SHA-512 digests.
- [Cron Schedule Expression Builder & Next-Run Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/cron-expression-generator/): Validate 5-field crontab schedules, read an instant human-readable translation, and preview the exact upcoming execution timestamps.
- [YAML ↔ JSON Bi-Directional Converter & Validator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/yaml-to-json/): Switch seamlessly between clean indented YAML manifests and strict JSON objects right in your browser.
- [XML ↔ JSON DOM Parser & Pretty Converter](https://utilforge.pages.dev/xml-to-json/): Uses your browser’s native DOMParser to transform XML nodes, attributes, and text elements into clean JSON.
- [UUID v4 / Time-Ordered v7 & ULID Bulk Generator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/uuid-generator/): Powered by WebCrypto CSPRNG (crypto.getRandomValues) for collision-free database primary keys and distributed IDs.
- [Unix Epoch Timestamp ↔ ISO-8601 Date & Timezone Converter](https://utilforge.pages.dev/unix-timestamp-converter/): Auto-detects 10-digit seconds vs. 13-digit milliseconds, translates to UTC and local timezones, and computes relative time deltas.
- [Markdown ↔ HTML Compiler & Live Preview Studio](https://utilforge.pages.dev/markdown-to-html/): Convert headings, fenced code blocks, lists, blockquotes, and links into clean HTML5 markup ready for blogs or documentation.
- [HEX / RGB / HSL Color Converter & WCAG 2.1 Contrast Checker](https://utilforge.pages.dev/color-contrast-converter/): Enter a foreground and background HEX color pair to compute exact luminance contrast ratios and CSS custom property tokens.
- [Linux Chmod Octal (755 / 644) & Symbolic Permission Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/chmod-calculator/): Convert 3-digit octal modes or 9-character symbolic strings into Owner, Group, and Public read/write/execute matrices and ready-to-run shell commands.
- [URL Slug, camelCase, snake_case & Reading Time Analyzer](https://utilforge.pages.dev/case-slug-converter/): Generate clean URL slugs and code identifiers simultaneously while measuring word count, character length, and estimated reading time.
- [TOML ↔ JSON Config Converter & Validator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/toml-to-json/): Bi-directional TOML ↔ JSON parser for tables, nested sections, arrays, and inline key-value configs—executed 100% inside your browser tab.
- [cURL to Fetch, Axios & Python Requests Converter](https://utilforge.pages.dev/curl-to-fetch/): Paste any cURL command from Chrome DevTools or API docs and instantly generate clean JavaScript Fetch, Axios, or Python Requests code with headers and JSON body parsed.
- [SVG Minifier, Cleanup & Data URI Encoder](https://utilforge.pages.dev/svg-optimizer/): Strip bloated XML comments, editor metadata, and redundant whitespace from Figma or Illustrator SVGs, and generate URL-encoded or Base64 CSS Data URIs.
- [URL Query String Parser, UTM Inspector & Parameter Builder](https://utilforge.pages.dev/url-parser-builder/): Break any URL or webhook callback link into protocol, host, path segments, and decoded JSON query parameters with instant UTM campaign auditing.
- [Cryptographic Password, API Key & Entropy Generator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/password-entropy-generator/): Powered by browser hardware CSPRNG (window.crypto.getRandomValues) with real-time Shannon & pool entropy bit calculation and offline crack-time estimation.
- [Data Size (KB / MB / GB / TB vs KiB / MiB / GiB) & Transfer Time Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/byte-unit-converter/): Eliminate Base-10 vs Base-2 cloud storage confusion and calculate exact network transfer durations across 100 Mbps, 1 Gbps, and 10 Gbps links.
- [JSON to JSON Schema (Draft-07 / 2020-12) & TypeScript Interface Generator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/json-schema-generator/): Paste a sample API response to infer required keys, nested object schemas, array item types, and ready-to-compile TypeScript interfaces.
- [HTML Entity Encoder / Decoder & XSS Sanitization Inspector](https://utilforge.pages.dev/html-entity-encoder/): Escape raw HTML snippets, code blocks, and untrusted user strings into safe named (&amp;lt;) or numeric (&#x3C;) entities—or decode escaped HTML back to readable markup.
- [SQL CREATE TABLE → Prisma Schema, Zod & TypeScript Converter](https://utilforge.pages.dev/sql-to-prisma-zod/): Paste PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQLite CREATE TABLE statements to instantly generate Prisma ORM models, Zod runtime validation schemas, or TypeScript types.
- [SVG to React JSX / TSX & Tailwind Component Converter](https://utilforge.pages.dev/svg-to-jsx/): Automatically camelCases SVG attributes (stroke-width → strokeWidth, class → className), forwards SVGProps, and replaces hardcoded colors with currentColor.
- [.env to Kubernetes ConfigMap / Secret, Docker Compose & JSON Converter](https://utilforge.pages.dev/env-to-k8s-docker/): Transform local .env key-value files into Kubernetes ConfigMap YAML, Base64-encoded K8s Secret manifests, Docker Compose environment blocks, or Cloudflare wrangler.json.
- [CSV / TSV / JSON to GitHub Markdown & LaTeX Table Generator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/csv-to-markdown-table/): Paste spreadsheet rows or CSV data to generate perfectly padded GitHub Flavored Markdown tables, LaTeX tabular environments, or HTML tables.
- [IPv4 CIDR Subnet Mask, Range & AWS/Cloud VPC Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/cidr-subnet-calculator/): Enter any CIDR block (like 10.0.0.0/16 or 192.168.1.0/24) to inspect network address, broadcast IP, wildcard mask, binary netmask, and AWS VPC usable host counts.
- [Cron Expression to Human English Explainer & systemd Timer Converter](https://utilforge.pages.dev/cron-to-english/): Paste any 5-field crontab schedule to get an instant plain-English explanation, field-by-field breakdown, next 5 run timestamps, and an equivalent systemd .timer unit.
- [HAR File & HTTP Headers Security / Waterfall Analyzer](https://utilforge.pages.dev/har-analyzer/): Paste raw HTTP response headers or a HAR JSON entry to audit HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, CORS policies, and Cache-Control directives with 100% local privacy.
- [Base64 Image / SVG / JSON Data URI Decoder & Live Visual Previewer](https://utilforge.pages.dev/base64-data-uri-previewer/): Paste any data:image/... Base64 URI or raw Base64 payload to inspect MIME headers, exact decoded byte size, hex magic bytes, and live visual rendering.
- [Freelance Hourly Rate, Billable Utilization & Self-Employment Tax Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/freelance-rate-tax-calculator/): Model target take-home salary, self-employment + income taxes, non-billable utilization, PTO weeks, and software overhead 100% locally in your browser.
- [SaaS LTV:CAC, Churn, Payback Period & ARR Unit Economics Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/saas-ltv-cac-calculator/): Instant VC-grade unit economics modeling for SaaS founders: compute Customer Lifetime Value (LTV), CAC payback period, Net Dollar Retention impact, and 12-month ARR projection.
- [LLM Prompt Token Counter & Multi-Model API Cost Estimator (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, o3-mini)](https://utilforge.pages.dev/llm-token-cost-estimator/): Paste any system prompt, RAG context, or JSON schema to measure BPE token count and compare exact per-call and monthly production costs across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and DeepSeek.
- [Client-Side SVG QR Code & Wi-Fi / vCard Payload Studio](https://utilforge.pages.dev/svg-qr-code-studio/): Construct RFC-compliant WIFI:, BEGIN:VCARD, mailto:, and UTM-tagged strings with instant deterministic SVG visual matrix rendering.
- [Stripe vs PayPal vs Lemon Squeezy Net Payout & Fee Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/stripe-paypal-fee-calculator/): Compare exact credit card processing fees, merchant of record splits, and net take-home revenue across Stripe, PayPal, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle, and Polar with 100% local browser execution.
- [AWS S3 vs Cloudflare R2 Storage & Egress Bandwidth Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/aws-s3-vs-cloudflare-r2-egress-calculator/): Audit monthly storage bills, Class A/B API request charges, and egress bandwidth penalties across AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Google Cloud Storage, and Backblaze B2.
- [SAFE Note & Seed Round Founder Equity Dilution Calculator](https://utilforge.pages.dev/startup-equity-dilution-calculator/): Model post-money vs. pre-money YC SAFE notes, valuation caps, discount rates, employee option pool expansions, and Seed round dilution 100% locally in your browser.
- [Vector Database & Embedding Cost Calculator (Pinecone vs Supabase vs Qdrant vs Vectorize)](https://utilforge.pages.dev/rag-vector-db-cost-estimator/): Calculate monthly vector database bills, index RAM consumption, read/write query costs, and embedding storage across Pinecone, Supabase pgvector, Qdrant Cloud, and Cloudflare Vectorize.
